lesson.subject: Mathematics
lesson.subtopic: Simplification of algebraic expressions: order of operations, brackets and word problems

curriculum.objective: Perform basic arithmetic operations on expressions of similar terms
Solve quantitative aptitude problems on the use of brackets

objectives.objective: carry out order of operation in algebra
solve word problems involving algebraic expression

entry-behaviour.item: Addition and subtraction of algebraic terms

references.item: New General Mathematics for JSS1 by M.F. Macrae and co.

step.title: Step 0 — intro: activating prior knowledge
step.plan-content: Teacher recalls with the students what they have already been taught, so the order-of-operations work has something to stand on:

step.title: Step 1 — order of operations in algebra
step.plan-content: Teacher solves some questions in order of operation on the board while students listen, contribute, and where necessary ask questions where they do not understand, copy worked examples into their notes, and as well solve some questions independently.

step.title: Step 2 — insertion and removal of brackets
step.plan-content: Teacher solves some questions on insertion, removal of bracket on the board while students listen, ask questions on their areas of difficulty, copy worked examples into their notes and as well solve some questions independently. Teacher moves round to monitor their work, answer their questions, marks their notes and makes corrections.

step.title: Evaluation
step.plan-content:
1. Simplify
(a) $14pq \times r$
(b) $12x^2y \div 3x$
2. Simplify $7 \times 3a - (3a + 5a) \times 2$
3. Simplify $12 - (7 - 2f) - (3 - f)$
4. Simplify $(8a - 5) + (14 - 3a)$
5. A pen and a pencil altogether cost $x$ naira. If a pen cost $y$ naira, find the cost of 3 pencils.
**Summary.** Teacher does correction on the given exercises.
**Conclusion.** Teacher marks students notes and give assignment.
